cases.note: Given name and surname are genuinely both 'Khalifé'. Sénateur de la Moselle since 24 Sept 2023. The two forms differ only in case and diacritics.

'Peter' is a usage nickname distinguishing him from his father, also Jean-Pierre Vigier, whom he succeeded as maire de Lavoûte-Chilhac in 2008. Canonical form is Jean-Pierre Vigier. Distinct from Philippe Vigier (28).
The slash is genuine - Breton abbreviation of the prefix 'Ker-', pronounced Kerbidi. The RNE strips it because its surname field does not tolerate '/'.
